title: Design System: 片刻剪趣

scope.world: Marketing surfaces only (homepage, pricing, 404) under the .mk wrapper in MarketingLayout: a Taiwanese lifestyle-magazine first issue.
scope.outOfScope: App surfaces (editor, dashboard, account, admin, auth) keep their own Operate grammar (Plus Jakarta Sans / Noto Sans TC, rounded-xl, --shadow-card / --shadow-pop, brand red #d42c22). The shared mark is the logo (ink square, white play, red dot).
scope.decided: Owner replaced the receipt world with the 生活雜誌 direction (2026-10-27): neutral magazine paper, ink, one cobalt issue colour; brand red only in the logo dot.

components.name: mkButton ink
components.description: Solid ink, square, hover turns cobalt.

components.name: mkButton paper
components.description: White paper button on the cobalt back cover.

components.name: RunningHead
components.description: Hairline running head: 刊名 left, page number and section right.

components.name: PlanCards
components.description: Two plan columns between ink rules; featured header in cobalt.

components.name: Cover / EditDemo
components.description: Vertical 明體 title, cobalt demo block with phone, interactive cover lines.

narrative: Creative North Star 「創刊號」: the homepage is the first issue of a Taiwanese lifestyle magazine about cutting one short video. Paper and ink with one committed cobalt; 明體 headings and folios, 黑體 prose, 霞鶩文楷 notes; vertical cover title; hairline rules instead of cards.
